notes.title: Version 7.4 Released - New save system
notes.content:
Version 7.4 has now been Released to Steam !

This updates includes some minor changes but most importantly it includes the new save system.  Now you can save & quit during a run and be able to resume your game at any time later, even after closing the game, turning off your PC etc.

If you don't see version 7.4 at the top left of the main menu in game, you can go to Properties->Local Files for the game listing in your Steam Library to 'Verify Integrity Of Game Files' and that will trigger a download of the update.

Have fun !

In the next few weeks an update to the game will be uploaded to Steam that includes the new save system that is already in the works and almost finished. Keep an eye out for the updated Alpha 7.3 version to hit Steam by the end of this week !!

notes.title: Cyber City Escape - A cyberpunk roguelite topdown shooter now with playable demo
notes.content:
Cyber City Escape is a 3D topdown roguelite shooter set in a cyberpunk world.

This demo is a unique look at the game features, it is NOT balanced. You will be exposed to many of the game dangers without having already upgraded your character and weapons. Just have fun, and expect to die !!

The game features:

- Procedurally generated maps
- Fog of war fueled exploration
- Multiple weapon types to unlock, acquire and upgrade
- Multiple enemy types with different fighting styles
- Environmental hazards, traps, explosive barrels, gun turrets
- Permadeath (if you run out of respawn modules)
- Equipment to purchase at kiosks to help you survive your run
- A token system for permanent progression in the form of character upgrades
- Dark and gritty atmosphere with matching story
- A retro future soundtrack with thumping beats

Can you master the urban death trap and find your way to freedom?

*** This game is still under development, and game balance will be tweaked during Early Access - all feedback is treasured ***
